headline: Saint Anselm end Pace's unbeaten start
dek: Pace had gone six matches without defeat, and conceded four goals in them, before losing at Saint Anselm. Southern New Hampshire are now the only programme yet to lose, and Southern Connecticut the only one yet to win.
displaced_by: Pace lost at Saint Anselm, their first defeat; the standing dek's claim that Pace have still to lose is no longer true

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Southern New Hampshire's twenty-six goals are spread across at least thirteen scorers, so no single player carries the tallest bar; Saint Anselm have won four of their six matches while scoring ten and conceding eleven, so the chart's order is not the order of results.

wire.line: Southern New Hampshire are the last programme yet to lose after Saint Anselm ended Pace's unbeaten start.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Southern New Hampshire have won five matches and drawn two, and are the only programme without a defeat.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cody Holbert has scored nine of Assumption's eighteen goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Saint Michael's have lost four matches, more than any other programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Joe Zweben has made thirty-eight saves, more than any other goalkeeper listed.

last_match.line: Saint Anselm have yet to draw a match this season; Pace had yet to lose one.

next_match.line: Southern New Hampshire are the only programme yet to lose; Saint Anselm have just ended the conference's other unbeaten start.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
